body:
## What to build

Preserve ordinary R dots forwarding when a visible local summary selector receives its columns through an inline function. The ordinary-summary contract and ADRs 0007/0019 retain the expression's evaluation environment.

On main `978d7bef4247bf1348af5b90bfab47924db25500`, a one-column input with x equal to one, two and three is enough: an inline function forwarding its populated dots to across returns x = 6 through ordinary dplyr, while summarize_with_margins raises `'...' used in an incorrect context`. Forwarding the first dots argument through `..1` instead raises a nonexistent-column error. The same boundary affects if_any and if_all.

The retained matrix contains 432 ordinary-success/Margin-failure comparisons and 45 successful wrapper controls. Formal promise capture receives the populated selector, whereas resolving its raw quoted dots symbol reproduces the failure.

[Minimized reproduction, causal controls and matrix](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/49e1d16ff42ba33f776e25bc5e895d4296f24371/investigation/2026-11-02-summary-grouping-share-bug-hunt/summary/README.md). Report mode exits zero; the desired-behavior assertion exits one. Tested with R 4.6.1, dplyr 1.2.1 and tidyselect 1.2.1. Full bodies/comments of closed #621, #925, #827 and #1002 were checked; those concern other argument boundaries or column names. All-state issue/PR searches found no matching populated-forwarding report.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Populated positional dots, named column forwarding, whole helper-argument forwarding and first-dots-argument selectors agree with ordinary dplyr for across, if_any and if_all on supported eager inputs.
- [ ] Cover unpartitioned, fixed-key and rollup summaries, named/unnamed outputs and a preceding independent summary at the public verb.
- [ ] Preserve the successful selection-wrapper and function-forwarding controls, grouping-column exclusion, output collision checks and contextual-share dependency refusals.
- [ ] Preserve ordinary evaluation order and environments without evaluating the caller's summary during static planning.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).
title: [P2] Preserve populated dots forwarding in local summary selectors
